purpose: Localize exact-output nondeterminism by comparing one-GPU and two-GPU executions at the same short c16 HTTP shape.
reason_for_shape: c64 reproduced nondeterminism but a fully synchronized batch required about 148 seconds. c16 retains diverse simultaneous prompts and 128-token trajectories while making topology isolation substantially cheaper.
pilot_order: TP1 control pilot: generate a non-publishable 16-row token-ID oracle
TP2 control pilot: generate a non-publishable 16-row token-ID oracle
pilot_gates: Each pilot must form one admission cohort, complete 16/16 128-token responses, use zero cached prompt tokens, preserve complete token-ID isolation, have zero cross-base collisions, remain WDC-negative, and have clean kernel/server evidence.
post_pilot_policy: Freeze each topology's oracle and its SHA-256, then preregister one fresh replay per topology. Stop a topology on any result below 16/16. Pilot and replay throughput are diagnostic until exactness passes.

interpretation.TP1_fail_TP2_fail: Prioritize kernels and numerical paths shared by both topologies.
interpretation.TP1_pass_TP2_pass: The issue may require c64 pressure; increase concurrency only after preserving exactness.
interpretation.TP1_fail_TP2_pass: Investigate the TP1 placement/kernel selection independently.
